hebrewText: וַ/יְהִ֨י אֹמֵ֜ן אֶת הֲדַסָּ֗ה הִ֤יא אֶסְתֵּר֙ בַּת דֹּד֔/וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין לָ֖/הּ אָ֣ב וָ/אֵ֑ם וְ/הַ/נַּעֲרָ֤ה יְפַת תֹּ֨אַר֙ וְ/טוֹבַ֣ת מַרְאֶ֔ה וּ/בְ/מ֤וֹת אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אִמָּ֔/הּ לְקָחָ֧/הּ מָרְדֳּכַ֛י ל֖/וֹ לְ/בַֽת

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
tokens.kjv: hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish, [phrase] fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: Hadassah (or Esther)
tokens.kjv: Hadassah.

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: Ester, the Jewish heroine
tokens.kjv: Esther.

tokens.bdb: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, [idiom] first, [idiom] old, [phrase] owl, town, village.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.enLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.explanation: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.explanationEn: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship

tokens.bdb: (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle
tokens.kjv: (well-) beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

tokens.bdb: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
tokens.kjv: dam, mother, [idiom] parting.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mother ; in a wide sense )
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mother ; in a wide sense )
tokens.explanation: a mother ; in a wide sense )
tokens.explanationEn: a mother ; in a wide sense )

tokens.bdb: a girl (from infancy to adolescence)
tokens.kjv: damsel, maid(-en), young (woman).

tokens.bdb: beautiful (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] beautiful, beauty, comely, fair(-est, one), [phrase] goodly, pleasant, well.

tokens.bdb: outline, i.e. figure or appearance
tokens.kjv: [phrase] beautiful, [idiom] comely, countenance, [phrase] fair, [idiom] favoured, form, [idiom] goodly, [idiom] resemble, visage.

tokens.bdb: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
tokens.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.enLiteralWord: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.explanation: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.explanationEn: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun

tokens.bdb: a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision
tokens.kjv: [idiom] apparently, appearance(-reth), [idiom] as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

tokens.bdb: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
tokens.kjv: (be) dead(-ly), death, die(-d).

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: Mordecai, an Israelite
tokens.kjv: Mordecai.

tokens.bdb: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
